steps.title: Sterilize coverslips
steps.instruction: Place 13 mm coverslips in a glass beaker, microwave on full power for 5 min, cover the beaker with cling film and aluminum foil, and store at room temperature until use.

steps.title: Seed Cos-7 cells
steps.instruction: Add 500 µl complete DMEM/F12 medium containing 1–3 × 10⁴ cells ml⁻¹ to each well of a 24‑well plate with a sterilized coverslip to achieve ~30 % confluency the next day; ensure cells are <50 % confluent on the day of transfection.

steps.title: Transfect DDR1 plasmid
steps.instruction: Prepare per well: 50 µl OptiMEM, 0.25 µg ml⁻¹ DNA, and 0.75 µl Fugene HD; incubate 15 min at room temperature, add drop‑wise to cells (medium changed to fresh complete DMEM/F12 1 h before addition). After 4 h replace with fresh complete DMEM/F12 and incubate further 24 h.

steps.title: Serum‑starve cells
steps.instruction: Aspirate medium, add 500 µl serum‑free DMEM/F12 per well, and incubate 16 h before bead stimulation.

steps.title: Coat beads with collagen
steps.instruction: Perform the following substeps (one day before stimulation):

substeps.instruction: Vortex 3 mm latex beads thoroughly and aliquot 1 µl starting bead volume per well (scale proportionally for multiple wells) into 1.5 ml Eppendorf tubes.
Wash beads: add 1 ml distilled water, centrifuge 4 000 rpm (1 236 × g) for 1 min, aspirate supernatant.
Resuspend beads in 1 ml bead‑coating buffer, centrifuge 4 000 rpm (1 236 × g) for 1 min, aspirate; repeat the water‑wash step once more.
Resuspend beads in 500 µl coating buffer containing 20 µg ml⁻¹ collagen I (or 20 µg ml⁻¹ BSA for control).
Incubate overnight on a rotating wheel at 4 °C.
Next day, add 500 µl 1× PBS, centrifuge 4 000 rpm (1 236 × g) for 1 min, aspirate to remove unbound collagen.
Wash beads with 1 ml 1× PBS, centrifuge 4 000 rpm (1 236 × g) for 1 min, aspirate.
Add 1 ml 1 % (w/v) BSA in 1× PBS, incubate 1 h on rotating wheel at room temperature, centrifuge 4 000 rpm (1 236 × g) for 1 min, aspirate.
Resuspend the beads in serum‑free DMEM/F12; beads are now ready (use 1 µl starting bead volume resuspended in 200 µl serum‑free DMEM/F12 per well).

steps.title: Stimulate cells with beads
steps.instruction: Aspirate serum‑free medium from the coverslips, vortex the prepared beads, add 200 µl bead suspension per well, centrifuge the plate at 1 200 rpm (290 × g) for 1 min to settle beads, and incubate at 37 °C for the desired time (10 min to 4 h).

steps.title: Wash post‑stimulation
steps.instruction: Wash each coverslip three times with 500 µl ice‑cold 1× PBS.

steps.title: Label surface DDR1
steps.instruction: Place coverslips face‑down on parafilm over a metal block on ice, add 30 µl primary anti‑DDR1 antibody (2.5 µg ml⁻¹ in 8 % BSA, 1× PBS), incubate 1 h on ice; then return coverslips to the well (cell side up) and wash three times with 500 µl 1× PBS on ice.

steps.title: Fix cells
steps.instruction: Add 500 µl 4 % paraformaldehyde in 1× PBS to each well, incubate 15 min at room temperature in a chemical fume hood, then discard the fixative safely.

steps.title: Wash after fixation
steps.instruction: Wash coverslips three times with 500 µl 1× PBS, aspirating after each wash (all steps at room temperature).

steps.title: Permeabilize cells
steps.instruction: Add 500 µl 0.1 % (v/v) Triton X‑100 in 1× PBS, incubate 5 min at room temperature, then aspirate.

steps.title: Block non‑specific binding
steps.instruction: Incubate coverslips in 8 % BSA (w/v) in 1× PBS for 1 h at room temperature.

steps.title: Label phospho‑DDR1
steps.instruction: Place coverslips face‑down on parafilm on ice, add 30 µl primary anti‑phospho‑DDR1 antibody (1:1 000 dilution in 8 % BSA, 1× PBS), incubate 1 h on ice; return coverslips to the well (cell side up) and wash three times with 500 µl 1× PBS.

steps.title: Apply secondary antibodies
steps.instruction: Place coverslips face‑down on parafilm on ice, add 30 µl appropriate secondary antibodies (1:500 dilution, ≈4 µg ml⁻¹, in 8 % BSA, 1× PBS), incubate 30 min protected from light; then return coverslips to the well (cell side up) and wash three times with 500 µl 1× PBS.

steps.title: Mount coverslips
steps.instruction: Place each coverslip on a microscope slide with 10 µl Prolong Gold mounting medium, air‑dry overnight at room temperature protected from light, then store at 4 °C or proceed to imaging.

steps.title: Acquire fluorescence images
steps.instruction: Image on a widefield microscope using a 60× oil objective; capture beads in brightfield, total DDR1 in FITC channel, and phosphorylated DDR1 in TRITC channel.
